scope: Acoustic-only CPU input through CPU waveform. Per-call RunOptions is inside session.run timing. WDDM snapshots occur after 150 ms at boundaries, not transient peaks or exclusive VRAM. No inference was rerun while assembling this file.

policies.after-long: gpu:0 shrink only for the named long case; a diagnostic rule, not an automatic length threshold
policies.always: gpu:0 shrink for every acoustic session.run

official_sources.finding: gpu:0 supported; default empty means no shrinking
Selected Run ends scan arena for unused regions; intended for occasional large dynamic requests
kSameAsRequested considers all regions, including the initial region; regions with live chunks are retained

counter_metadata.measurement: process-attributed WDDM counters; not exclusive VRAM
counter_metadata.aggregation: none; shared allocations may be counted for multiple PIDs
counter_metadata.residency: Total Committed is not a residency measurement

counters.explanation: Dedicated memory used by the adapter
Shared memory used by the adapter
Total committed memory used by the adapter
